compos.text: Alt text: "Instructions for setting up a player. The text explains that after pressing the 'next' button, the player will show a selection of helpful preferences. It emphasizes the need to set the 'main folder' for the player, which works strictly on a folder basis. Users are advised to select only the folder containing their audiobooks to avoid long scanning times. The player checks common locations like 'Audio Books' on SD and offers them in the initial list. Users can choose 'other folder' if their desired folder is not listed. All other preferences are optional. Additional options can be found under 'Configuration' - 'Preferences' in the menu."
Text displaying "Please configure" in blue font.
Alt text: "Smartphone status bar showing multiple Facebook notifications, Wi-Fi signal strength icon, Bluetooth icon, battery icon, and the time 1:11."
"MortPlayer Audio Books" logo with an icon of a stylized face wearing headphones.
Alt text: "Back button icon, represented by a left-pointing triangle."
Button with text "next >>" indicating navigation to the next page or step.

compos.summarization:
The given smartphone UI screen is from the "MortPlayer Audio Books" app. It is a configuration screen that guides the user through setting up the app. The main contents and functions of this screen include:

1. **Title**: "Please configure" - indicating that the user needs to configure the app.
2. **Instructions**: Detailed instructions are provided on how to set up the main folder for audio books. The app is folder-based, so users need to select a main folder where their audio books are stored. 
3. **Scanning Tips**: Users are advised to select only the folder containing their audio books to avoid long scanning times.
4. **Common Locations**: The app checks common locations like "Audio Books" on the SD card and offers them in the initial list. Users can choose "other folder" if their desired folder is not listed.
